base_image.note: Pinned by digest in container/apptainer.def (From: python@sha256:...). CI re-resolves the tag and fails the build when the digest no longer matches.

oci_digest.note: The built SIF digest is computed in CI (sha256 of the SIF artifact) and attached to the build summary and release; it is not knowable from the source tree. This is an OCI/Apptainer content address, not a registry push — BioNexus does not publish to a registry; labs pull the release artifact or build from the pinned definition.

lockfile.compile_command: uv pip compile --python-version 3.11 --generate-hashes pyproject.toml container/requirements.in --extra goldchain --extra scverse --extra spatial --extra deseq --extra survival --extra allotrope --extra mcp -o container/requirements-lock.txt
lockfile.hashes: every entry carries wheel SHA-256 hashes; pip hash-checking mode verifies them at install time, which is also the offline supply-chain control

sbom.note: Records the exact resolved versions the image installs (not pyproject specifiers).

gpu.requirement: host NVIDIA driver + CUDA 12 userspace injected by --nv; the Linux torch build in the lockfile carries CUDA kernels
gpu.note: CI runners have no GPU: the GPU profile is exercised on HPC nodes via cluster/slurm/profiles/hpc-gpu.sbatch. The image self-check verifies the stack imports, never that a GPU is present.

offline.note: Forces the OFFLINE_STRICT egress mode (zero hosted endpoints) regardless of other configuration; the gate runs in the image %test and in the Slurm reference profiles.

scale_benchmark_evidence.machine_class: small single node (8 cores, 8 GB RAM, Windows)
small single node (8 cores, 8 GB RAM, Windows)
small single node (8 cores, 8 GB RAM, Windows)

honesty.executed_runs: The committed scale-benchmark reports were really executed (wall time, peak memory, machine fingerprint recorded per report); they are single small-node runs, NOT HPC runs. Top-lab HPC evidence requires running cluster/slurm/profiles/run_scale_benchmark.sbatch on the target cluster and committing the resulting report.
ci_validated: image build with pinned base digest and locked wheels (fails closed on self-check)
doctor + offline gate + three firewall entry points inside the image
preflight smoke gate against committed real data
site_adapted: GPU execution (--nv on a GPU node; CI has no GPU)
site module names and scheduler behaviors
honesty.adoption_boundary: A digest, lockfile, SBOM, or benchmark report is deployment engineering evidence. It is not independent scientific validation (see BNS-023) and not institutional adoption or endorsement.
